response.sql: WITH tel_avg AS (SELECT t.equipstatus AS equipstatus, t.telescregistry AS tel, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS tavg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.equipstatus, t.telescregistry), status_avg AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(tavg) AS savg FROM tel_avg WHERE tavg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipstatus), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(savg) AS mean1 FROM status_avg), kept1 AS (SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.savg, sa.savg - m1.mean1 AS ex1 FROM status_avg sa CROSS JOIN m1 WHERE sa.savg > m1.mean1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(savg) AS mean2 FROM kept1), kept2 AS (SELECT k.equipstatus, k.savg, k.ex1, k.savg - m2.mean2 AS ex2 FROM kept1 k CROSS JOIN m2 WHERE k.savg > m2.mean2) SELECT AVG(savg) AS avg_pulse_rate, AVG(ex1) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(ex2) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM kept2
